description.value: Analog Coffee is a specialty coffee chain founded in Calgary in 2011, now operating multiple locations including this Vancouver café on Helmcken Street. The brand is built around an obsessive pursuit of sourcing and carefully crafting single-origin coffees, using innovative equipment and celebrating the skill of individual baristas. Touring cyclists stopping here will find a community-focused café with both indoor and outdoor seating in a wheelchair-accessible space.
